capabilities: Typeset a manifest note's chapters into a print-ready paperback PDF
Generate an EPUB 3 with navigation, landmarks and embedded fonts
Build front and back matter, cover and spine for KDP
Run a KDP preflight check and details sheet
Render Mermaid blocks as print-resolution figures
disambiguation: Not a digital-garden or site publishing tool; it produces a print PDF and an EPUB 3 file, not a hosted web book.
extras: Free edition; a separate paid Book Studio Pro (genre themes, back-of-book index, editions, box sets, accessible-EPUB pack) is announced as not on sale yet. Also available as a standalone web app sharing the same engine. Needs Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; works on desktop and mobile. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn a vault or folder of notes into a properly typeset, print-ready paperback PDF or a store-ready EPUB 3 without external tools like Pandoc or LaTeX.
summary: Local typesetting tool that turns a folder of Markdown notes into a print-ready paperback PDF for Amazon KDP and an EPUB 3, with no uploads.
